name: hvac-plan

brief.objective: Decide whether to launch HVAC scheduling software in the US at $40-$70 per technician per month.

intake.market_definition: Scheduling and dispatch software for HVAC contractors with fewer than 20 employees; excludes enterprise suites, plumbing and electrical

notes: Workspace: inputs/brief.md only; m1 has no network.
